_about: Cyclohexane (1) + Diethyl carbonate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 100.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of cyclohexane, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of cyclohexane, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: B. Marrufo, S. Loras, E. Lladosa, Phase Equilibria Involved in the Extractive Distillation of Cyclohexane + Cyclohexene Using Diethyl Carbonate as an Entrainer, J. Chem. Eng. Data 56 (2011) 4790-4796
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 2, 3. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0051. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
